name: Human — Variant
asi: +1 to two different ability scores of your choice
languages: Common, plus one extra language of your choice

traits.d: You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.
You gain one feat of your choice. (Optional rule; requires DM approval.)

You have draconic ancestry. Choose one type of dragon; your breath weapon and damage resistance are determined by it: Black (acid), Blue (lightning), Brass (fire), Bronze (lightning), Copper (acid), Gold (fire), Green (poison), Red (fire), Silver (cold), White (cold).

As an action, you exhale destructive energy; the shape and save depend on your ancestry. Black (acid), Blue (lightning), Brass (fire), Bronze (lightning), and Copper (acid) breathe a 5 by 30 ft. line (Dexterity save). Gold (fire) and Red (fire) breathe a 15 ft. cone (Dexterity save). Green (poison), Silver (cold), and White (cold) breathe a 15 ft. cone (Constitution save). Each creature in the area makes the listed saving throw (DC 8 + your Constitution modifier + your proficiency bonus), taking 2d6 damage on a failed save, half as much on a success. The damage increases to 3d6 at 6th level, 4d6 at 11th, and 5d6 at 16th. After you use your breath weapon, you can’t use it again until you complete a short or long rest.
You have resistance to the damage type associated with your draconic ancestry.
